title: RentGuard Collection Ahead of Billing after Dishonoured Payments
content:
## Credit and collections standard — catch-up collection ahead of billing (RentGuard Renters Policy)

Catch-up collection ahead of billing after dishonoured payments: when two or more renters payments were returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months, the unbilled premium of the term, which is the annual premium less every installment already billed for the term and never below 0.00, is collected with the catch-up; when exactly one renters payment was returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months and a late charge was posted on the policy in the last 12 calendar months, the next scheduled installment is collected with the catch-up, taken at the amount of the latest installment billed together with the installment service charge of the policy's billing plan — the tier's EFT installment service charge on the monthly EFT plan and the tier's card installment service charge on any other plan; in every other case nothing is collected ahead of billing. The amount collected ahead of billing is added to the catch-up.

### Terms

- **Returned unpaid:** a renters payment the bank returned and the premium account reversed, posted within the last 12 calendar months.
- **Late charge:** a fee entry with fee code late fee posted on the policy's premium account within the last 12 calendar months.
- **Unbilled premium of the term:** the policy's current annual premium less every installment already billed for the current term, never below 0.00.
- **Latest installment billed:** the installment on the premium account with the latest due date.

### Condition matrix

| Returns in last 12 calendar months | Late charge in last 12 calendar months | Collected ahead of billing |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | Yes or no | The unbilled premium of the term |
| Exactly one | Yes | The next scheduled installment with its plan service charge |
| Exactly one | No | Nothing |
| None | Yes or no | Nothing |

### Hypothetical illustrations

- Two returns, annual premium 240.00 USD, installments billed for the term 140.00 USD: 100.00 USD is collected ahead of billing.
- Two returns, installments billed for the term already equal to the annual premium: the unbilled premium is 0.00 and nothing is added.
- One return and one late charge, monthly EFT plan, latest installment billed 20.00 USD, a hypothetical EFT service charge of 1.00 USD: 21.00 USD is collected ahead of billing.
- One return and no late charge: nothing is collected ahead of billing.
